Description & Requirements
 Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.
As a Senior Analyst, you will lead complex security investigations, coordinate incident responses, and mentor other team members. You will also lead the validation of new detections and participate in cross-team projects and tool evaluations. You will report directly to the Security Operations Director. This role works in shifts and includes on-call rotations as required.
 Responsibilities
 Lead multi-vector security investigations from end-to-end, including detection, containment, and root cause analysis (RCA).
 Be an Security Operations SME in cross-team projects and tool evaluations
 Validate new detections and data sources, providing technical feedback to the Engineering team.
 Mentor cybersecurity analysts on technical escalations, maintaining the investigation quality standards for the team.
 Identify improvements to security processes, playbooks, and automation by analyzing historical incident patterns.
 Participate in an on-call rotation to ensure 24x7 coverage
 Qualifications
 Practical experience applying incident response frameworks to analyze security events using SIEM, EDR, and network monitoring tools.
 Experience investigating multi-vector security incidents and coordinating containment tasks across IT and engineering teams.
 Technical proficiency with networking protocols, Active Directory architecture, and cloud security principles (SaaS/IaaS).
 Experience configuring and analyzing endpoint protection solutions and virtual environments.
 Experience drafting clear, technical incident write-ups and delivering structured verbal briefings to senior leadership during active high-severity incidents
 About Electronic Arts
 We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.
We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.
